description_en: Retrieves the lifecycle of an instance
name: GetLifecycle

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. For more information about how to obtain an instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: A session is the period from when an instance is started until it fails or is stopped. sessionNumber specifies the ordinal number offset of the session
parameters.help_zh: 一个Session为实例从启动到失败或停止的过程，sessionNumber表示实例Session的序号偏移值
parameters.name: session_number

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of sessions to return in the query
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The order in which to sort the results. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order by time.

DESC: descending order by time
parameters.help_zh:
结果的排序方式，取值如下：
ASC：按时间升序。
DESC：按时间降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: A token used for sharing URLs
parameters.name: token

schema.description_en: The result of the lifecycle query

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:

InternalError: An internal error occurred. This includes all errors except for parameter validation errors.

ValidationError: A parameter validation error occurred
Code.description_zh:
状态码，可能值：
InternalError：内部错误（除了参数验证错误外的其他错误，目前都归类到内部错误）。
ValidationError：参数验证错误

Lifecycle.description_en: The details of the instance lifecycle, organized by session
Lifecycle.description_zh: 获取到的实例生命周期详情

items.description_en: A list of lifecycles where each subkey represents the lifecycle of a Session
items.description_zh: 生命周期结果列表，每一个子项为一个Session对应的生命周期
其中一个Session对应的生命周期详情

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance transitioned to this state. The time is in GMT
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 该状态创建的时间，即流转到该状态的时间（GMT）

ReasonCode.description_en: The code for the reason why an event occurred
ReasonCode.description_zh: 发生某种事件的原因对应的代码

ReasonMessage.description_en: The description of the reason why an event occurred
ReasonMessage.description_zh: 发生某种事件的原因描述

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Possible values:

Creating: The instance is being created.

SaveFailed: Failed to save the instance image.

Stopped: The instance is stopped.

Failed: Failed to create the instance.

ResourceAllocating: Allocating resources.

Stopping: The instance is stopping.

Updating: The instance is being updated.

Saving: The instance is being saved.

Starting: The instance is starting.

Running: The instance is running.

Saved: The instance is saved.

EnvPreparing: Preparing the environment.

ArrearStopping: Stopping due to an overdue payment.

Arrearge: Stopped due to an overdue payment.

Queuing: The instance is waiting in a queue.

Recovering: The instance is being recovered
Status.description_zh:
实例所处的状态。可能值：
Creating：创建中。
SaveFailed：实例镜像保存失败。
Stopped：已停止。
Failed：实例创建失败。
ResourceAllocating：资源准备中。
Stopping：停止中。
Updating：更新中。
Saving：保存中。
Starting：启动中。
Running：运行中。
Saved：已保存。
EnvPreparing：环境准备中。
ArrearStopping：欠费停机中。
Arrearge：欠费停机。
Queuing：排队中。
Recovering：恢复中

Message.description_en: The message returned for the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
成功标志，可能值：
true
false

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of sessions returned
